title: Show HN: Automatically detect and patch walking-dead states in Sierra games
summary: The Lucasartsifier is a static analysis tool that decompiles Sierra game resource files to automatically detect unwinnable 'walking-dead' states where players get stuck without required items, then generates patch files to prevent these situations.
problem_solved: Prevents classic Sierra adventure game players from getting permanently stuck in unwinnable states due to missing required items from earlier game sections.
why_valuable: Preserves the playability of beloved 80s/90s Sierra games by automatically detecting and fixing game-breaking design flaws, making classic gaming more accessible.
